purpose: Deterministic offline fixtures for real-capacity joint research, withdrawal, asymmetric result usability, classified collaboration, communication disruption, and bounded long-run collaboration state.

scenarios.description: Two polities jointly pursue Stable Warp Drive. Both contribute real labs. Combined capacity uses the same single-project diminishing-return curve as domestic research; flags do not create separate scaling buckets.
assertions: joint project is faster than either contribution alone because real capacity is combined
combined lab scaling is evaluated once for the project
multi-polity labels cannot bypass diminishing returns
agreement applies no extra RP multiplier

scenarios.description: A participant withdraws 8 labs from a joint Stable Warp Drive program after records from earlier work already exist. Project continues with remaining capacity but progresses more slowly; completed work/records are not reversed.
assertions: future contribution is removed
existing project progress is preserved
already delivered records remain
remaining participants can continue if hard requirements still exist

scenarios.description: A partner supplies the only authorized xenoscience-containment facility required by a joint Hazardous Foreign Technology Protocols experiment. Removing facility access blocks the stage even though enough labs remain.
assertions: labs cannot substitute for a genuinely missing hard facility
withdrawal can block rather than merely slow a project
restoring equivalent legitimate facility access can unblock the stage

scenarios.description: Two participants jointly study foreign biological manufacturing records and receive the same codified theory/data, but only the compatible metabolic participant has suitable biology/facilities to operate/adapt the process immediately.
assertions: equal record access does not imply equal operability
biology/infrastructure compatibility remains participant-specific
joint foreign-tech study does not mature a native node automatically

scenarios.description: A two-polity classified Field Defense project divides theory, prototype-test, manufacturing-process, and control records into compartments. Each participant contributes useful work, but only a designated integration context receives all engineering-critical compartments.
assertions: joint program can integrate a result without every participant receiving every compartment
compartment restrictions do not split scientific truth
participants do not gain missing compartments merely because they contributed

scenarios.description: A joint long-baseline sensor project loses its high-bandwidth cross-polity data path for three years. Local collection continues, but cross-site correlation work that requires the remote dataset pauses until the path returns.
assertions: communication failure blocks only dependencies that actually need the path
local scientific work can continue
there is no universal cross-polity penalty
reconnection resumes pending delivery rather than recreating completed local work

scenarios.description: Reference 1,000-year collaboration workload across many diplomatic relationships. Only active/strategically relevant collaborations stay detailed; completed/terminated records compress.
rules: inactive agreements with no scientific work allocate no detailed research record
delivered result-transfer records are removed after participant state application
no participant technology graph is copied into collaboration state
